scope_limits: Pointwise Airy correction with o(n^(1/6)) remainder, not O(log n)
No multiplicative equivalent, amplitude, power prefactor, further terms or all-orders expansion
Threshold second term is asymptotic, not finite certified localization or exact rounding
Global cumulative shape; row shape only on compact subsets of (0,2 log 2)
Fixed-tolerance exponential concentration; no CLT, covariance, extreme-part law or fluctuation scale
Half limiting row mass on diagonal segment is not an exact-contact density claim
Finite exact checks and approximate illustrations do not prove asymptotic or probability theorems
